The current bug report describes an incorrect behavior related to binary operators involving node-sets in XPath. It mentions a discrepancy with the XPath specification regarding comparisons between node-sets and numbers.

To further investigate the root cause of the incorrect behavior in the binary operators involving node-sets, we should analyze the implementation within the `assertXPathValue` method in `org.apache.commons.jxpath.JXPathTestCase`.
